# Brand Context — Compliance

> TEST FIXTURE ONLY. The strings below are placeholders for pipeline testing.
> They are NOT real legal language and must never be copied into a production
> agent folder. Content Foundry enforces that this language is PRESENT and
> LEGIBLE; the brokerage supplies the WORDING. Assistive, not legal advice.

## License
- agent license number: TN Lic. #000000
- state: TN
- required placement: every public-facing asset, bottom edge, min 14px

## Brokerage disclosure
- disclosure text: "Testbrand Realty | Each office independently owned and operated."
- required on: all assets

## Fair Housing
- required language: "Equal Housing Opportunity."
- equal housing logo required? no
- logo path: n/a

## Banned claims and words
- guaranteed
- safest neighborhood
- perfect for families
- best schools

## Testimonial rules
- testimonials permitted? yes
- required attribution / disclaimer: "Client testimonial. Individual results vary."

## Auto-publish
- auto_publish: false
